Original local corpus preparation, group split, exact deduplication, archive final-answer extraction, bounded credential filtering and byte-level BPE tokenization. Private records are excluded from Git.

Pinned public-file downloads with complete size/SHA256 verification; distinct public-tool trace reader, reusable tokenizer, per-source token shards and deterministic token-weighted sampling. GPU admission preserves live waiters and foreign locks without CPG.

Added an experimental permanent n-gram PLE knowledge sidecar, bidirectional masked-diffusion auxiliary student layers with 8x residual internal width, and cache-fragment-stable block candidate selection.
Bound block-selector and PLE geometry plus an immutable semantic-capsule digest into an APCv2 identity contract without claiming a selected serving route.
Extended private Codex archive preparation to bounded tool calls and results while continuing to exclude hidden reasoning and reject credential-bearing trajectories.
